title: Cover standalone worker host-origin substitution before stage execution
outcome: Note scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs:2960 owner substitution before execution is tested but host URL substitution only at notify/recover. Add a behavioral executeRun control with swapped TERMAL_BASE_URL, failed run/all stages unrun/no stage side effect; preserve current guards.
acceptance: A standalone worker with substituted host origin is observably refused before any stage executes, without stage side effects.
